comment: Masked high-flux X/Y scan. 'latest' selects the newest readable 06_xy JSON plus FITS/NPZ pair below instrument.json output_root; use --source-json only for an intentional override.

scan_extent.comment: Asymmetric limits relative to the newest fitted Phot 1 centre. Decreasing mount X covers the right of the reconstructed MLA image; increasing mount Y covers its bottom. With a centre near (3050, 3468), this gives approximately X=2700..3200 and Y=3318..3718.

mask.comment: Default excludes the union of all photometry samples at or above 5% of each background-subtracted peak, plus a 10-pulse margin. Lower thresholds are more conservative but require a wider reference scan if the threshold contour reaches its boundary.

segment_overlap_mask.comment: GLINT 60-degree convention for a 65.2-pulse demagnified pitch: relative to segment 11, segment 20 is (-sqrt(3)*65.2, +2*65.2) and segment 31 is (0, +3*65.2). The measured Phot 2 or Phot 3 low-flux footprint from the newest XY scan is translated by the corresponding offset, then dilated by 45 pulses. The 45-pulse margin was validated against the segment-11 hexagon actually measured through microlens 20 in the previous HDR Photometry 2 map: it covers every measured pixel at or above 5% of that feature's background-subtracted peak. These regions are never acquired or crossed while segment 11 is flat.

acquisition.comment: The script tilts all 37 segments away before travelling to the first safe point, asks for LOW/reference flux, then makes only the selected segment flat. One low-flux pilot is checked before the READY prompt. At every science point, the first of nframes is a saturation probe; the remaining frames are read only if it is safe.

saturation_guard.comment: If any raw APAPANE pixel reaches 80% of the configured ADC ceiling, immediately tilt all DM segments away, abort and save partial results. Full-frame guarding also catches unexpected light outside the three photometry boxes. Verify adc_max_adu for the active camera mode.

normalization.comment: If the high-flux source/reference power ratio is calibrated, enter it here. High-flux maps are divided by this value and stitched to the low-flux reference inside the excluded region. Leave null to save unstitched raw high-flux maps.
